name: ROBOWARS - 15KG
short_description: Robowars is the flagship combat robotics event of RoboVITics at GraVITas, VIT Vellore, and South India's largest combat robotics event. Teams from across the country design, build, and battle their custom robots across multiple weight categories in a professionally designed arena. The competition celebrates engineering excellence, innovation, and strategic thinking while delivering an electrifying experience for participants and spectators alike.

name: Aerodominator
short_description: Aerodominator is a flagship fixed-wing aircraft design and flight competition at graVITas 2026, organised by the Society Of Automotive Engineering(SAE-VIT). Student teams are challenged to conceptualise, design, build, a radio-controlled (RC) fixed-wing aircraft from scratch — demonstrating engineering ingenuity, aerodynamic know-how, and hands-on fabrication skill.

name: CAPTURE THE FLAG (CTF 4.0)
short_description: Capture The Flag 4.0 (CTF 4.0) is the fourth edition of IEEE ComSoc VIT's flagship team-based tech hunt that combines logical reasoning, real time problem solving, and campus wide strategy. Teams of 7 to 10 members, depending on the total number of registrations, begin with a 15-minute challenge round consisting of 8 rapid fire questions based on technology, general knowledge, apps, and taglines. The time remaining after completing these questions determines the duration available for teams to hide their assigned colored flag across designated areas of the campus, excluding hostels and academic blocks, with assistance from event volunteers.  Once the hiding phase concludes, all teams return to the base point, and on the official signal, the hunt begins. Teams must locate and capture as many opposing flags as possible within the allotted time. This year, CTF 4.0 introduces enhanced gameplay through a dedicated event website featuring centralized tracking, streamlined question management, live leaderboards, and real time progress monitoring, ensuring a smoother and more competitive experience. The team that secures the highest number of flags and completes the final challenge in the shortest time will be crowned the winner.

name: ROBOWARS - 60KG
short_description: Robowars is the flagship combat robotics event of RoboVITics at GraVITas, VIT Vellore, and South India's largest combat robotics event. Teams from across the country design, build, and battle their custom robots across multiple weight categories in a professionally designed arena. The competition celebrates engineering excellence, innovation, and strategic thinking while delivering an electrifying experience for participants and spectators alike.

name: Embed Control 7.0
short_description: Get ready for Embed Control 7.0, our flagship 2-day workshop on the versatile ESP32 microcontroller! Enjoy hands-on sessions on embedded fundamentals, sensor interfacing, and real-world applications. Explore Wi-Fi and Bluetooth to build smart IoT and automation solutions. Ideal for beginners and tech enthusiasts!
tagline: Step into the World of Next-Gen Embedded Systems & IoT!

name: Nebula
short_description: Nebula is a beginner-friendly overnight workshop where a team of 5 build CyberDeck, a multifunctional AI companion featuring voice and touch interaction, multiple interactive modes, built-in games, IoT automation, a digital pet, music player, productivity tools, a smart dashboard, BMP180-based environmental sensing, and an e-reader mode. No prior experience is required. Learn, build, innovate, and take your creation home!
tagline: Craft intelligence, ignite innovation, and bring your companion to life.

name: ROBOWARS - 8KG
short_description: Robowars is the flagship combat robotics event of RoboVITics at GraVITas, VIT Vellore, and South India's largest combat robotics event. Teams from across the country design, build, and battle their custom robots across multiple weight categories in a professionally designed arena. The competition celebrates engineering excellence, innovation, and strategic thinking while delivering an electrifying experience for participants and spectators alike.

name: Code Cortex 3.0
short_description: Code Cortex 3.0 is a 30-hour AI/ML hackathon open to all students. Choose from curated tracks spanning finance, medicine, Drone Tech and Aviation and Security each built around a real dataset and problem space. While allowing you to explore your own idea through the Open Innovation track. Build something that works, explain what it does, and show what you learned. No prior experience needed. Just build something you want to see exist.

name: kARniVRse
short_description: Step into kARniVRse, an immersive arcade carnival packed with VR adventures, interactive challenges, classic arcade games, and a retro photobooth. Battle your friends, test your reflexes, chase high scores, and experience something new at every turn. Come play, compete, capture, and make memories! Also stand a chance to win a FREE MERCH everyday by playing the games!
tagline: An adventure too BIG for the REAL world

name: Quadcopter
short_description: SAE VIT along with team Rotor FPV presents Quadcopter, a drone building workshop where participants get to build, fly and take away the drone built as a team of 6. Participants will first learn all the fundamentals before working hands-on to build a drone from scratch which you will get to fly and keep for yourself (1 Drone per team).

name: SAE-Drone Racing League (DRL)
short_description: The Drone Racing League (DRL), organized by SAE-VIT as part of Gravitas 2026, is a high-speed FPV drone racing competition designed to test precision, agility, and piloting skills. Featuring a MultiGP-standard race track, the event includes Amateur and Professional categories, free practice, qualifying rounds, and an exciting final race. DRL brings together skilled pilots and technology enthusiasts for a competitive and immersive racing experience.

name: Manufacture Your Dream : RC Car Building and Racing
short_description: Manufacture Your Dream is an exciting RC car building and racing event hosted by the Society of Manufacturing Engineers at graVITas 2026. Teams work together to assemble a remote-controlled car from scratch using provided materials and then race it on a custom track. The fastest combined time wins, and the top three teams receive cash prizes.
tagline: Don't just dream it. Build It. Race It.

name: Best Management Team
short_description: ARKK - The Rebuild Protocol is the Best Management Team competition of VIT Business School's intercollegiate  management fest Invictus’26 flagship event of gravitas26 . Six rounds. One escalating crisis. Your team makes every call, adapt when the rules change, and defend your final decision live. Simple to understand. Brutal to master. No textbooks.  No jargon. Just your team's ability to lead when it actually matters. Open to all streams and colleges. Come find out what  your team is actually made of.
tagline: Prove you can lead when it matters.

name: Aerovision 2.0
short_description: Ever looked at a plane and wondered how it actually stays up there? AeroVision 2.0 is where you find out -  and then design one yourself. No prior aerospace knowledge needed, just show up curious. You'll go from aerodynamics 101 to hands-on with XFLR5 and Fusion 360, then put it all to the test in an overnight ideathon where your team designs, analyses, and pitches an original aircraft concept. It's the perfect first step into aerospace — real tools, real learning, real prizes (including a SolidWorks license) waiting at the finish line.
tagline: Where Ideas Take Flight - Design, Simulate, Soar.

name: REBORN x VALORANT
short_description: This event is a three-day team-based VALORANT tournament. Matches will be conducted according to a fixed schedule and basic rules to ensure fair play. The tournament is designed to be engaging while remaining organized and supervised, allowing students to enjoy the game responsibly as part of the cultural fest.

name: Go-Karting
short_description: Go-Karting, one of SAE-VIT's flagship premium events, returns to graVITas 2026 with three days of exhilarating racing action from 18th–20th September. Designed for participants of all experience levels, the event offers a professionally managed motorsport experience that combines speed, precision, and competition. This edition also aims to introduce an enhanced venue experience, promising participants a fresh and exciting atmosphere unlike previous years.
tagline: Race the Track. Own the Experience.

name: REBORN x FIFA
short_description: Grab your controllers and claim campus bragging rights! Join our 1v1 local EA FC 26 tournament. Face off head-to-head against fellow students in high-stakes, fast-paced matches on the big screen. Registration and slots are limited. Prove you’re the absolute best on the pitch—sign up now!

name: Engineering Intelligent Immersive Media
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: A two-day hands-on workshop exploring how Artificial Intelligence is shaping the future of immersive media. Participants will work with Computer Vision, Predictive AI, Spatial Computing and Large Language Models (LLMs) to create practical solutions for XR, gaming and interactive media. The workshop focuses on real-world applications, guided learning and hands-on project development, giving participants an opportunity to understand emerging technologies and build intelligent media experiences.

name: EnergyThon
short_description: Energython is an intensive hackathon and idea-thon organized by the Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) VIT Vellore for graVITas 2026. Designed to tackle pressing real-world challenges in the energy sector, teams of 1 to 5 members will ideate, design, and pitch innovative solutions across renewable energy integration, smart grids, energy efficiency, and sustainable urban mobility. Gear up to disrupt the current, demonstrate your technical creativity, and compete for a share of the ₹15,000 prize pool!
tagline: Sparking the Next Wave of Clean Tech

name: SAE Ideathon
short_description: SAE Ideathon a startup-themed event hosted by SAE VIT where participants step into the shoes of entrepreneurs and engineers to build the future of mobility. Unlike traditional technical competitions, this event focuses entirely on innovation, problem solving, and strategic thinking without requiring prior coding or engineering experience. Teams will identify a real-world mobility challenge and develop a comprehensive startup solution that balances technical feasibility, business strategy, and sustainability. Ultimately, it offers an immersive experience that mirrors how modern automotive companies transform a vision into a viable business.
tagline: Innovate Today. Drive the Mobility of Tomorrow.

name: Grooveathon
short_description: Grooveathon 2026 is a group dance competition where dance meets the unexpected. A three-day dance hackathon at VIT Vellore, where teams hunt, bid, create, adapt and perform their way through challenges that test more than just choreography. From earning Groove Coins to battling through creative twists and reviews, every move counts. Bring your crew, bring your style, and discover how far your algoRHYTHM can take you.

name: Aero-crafters
venue: MB 306, MB 306A, Kalpana Chawla Lawn - II
short_description: Dive into the fundamentals of aerospace engineering by learning the science of flight, aircraft design, and aerodynamics. Build and assemble your own aircraft under expert guidance while gaining hands-on engineering experience.

name: Right! A Tune
short_description: Right A Tune! is VIT Music Club’s flagship 48-hour overnight music production hackathon where participants collaborate to compose, record, produce, and mix original songs. Featuring expert-led workshops, creative challenges, networking opportunities, and a live showcase, the event brings together musicians and producers to learn, innovate, and compete for exciting cash prizes.

name: Wanna Crack GSoc 3.0
short_description: Step into open-source mastery with Innovators Quest's flagship workshop, Wanna Crack GSoC 2026. Featuring 2x GSoC Contributor Chirag Singh, this immersive session covers insider application strategies, essential Git and GitHub workflows, and real-world issue resolution through direct, hands-on mentorship.

name: PCBify 2.0
short_description: Are you curious about how electronic devices are built, or how complex circuits come to life on compact green boards? Here’s your chance to explore the fascinating world of Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) through an immersive, beginner-friendly workshop. Over the span of two days, participants will gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience in PCB design. Starting from the fundamentals of electronic circuits and schematic design, the workshop will guide students through design software tools, component placement, routing techniques, and industry standards. By the end of the workshop, attendees will have designed their very own PCB, bridging the gap between conceptual circuits and real-world applications.

name: VINHACK
short_description: VINHACK is the flagship 30-hour hackathon organized by VinnovateIT, the technical club behind MessIT and Latch, the campus's favorite apps. Bringing together developers, designers, and innovators, the event challenges participants to solve real-world problems through collaboration, mentorship, technical workshops, and networking with industry professionals.

name: Hydro Clash (Women)
short_description: Hydro Clash is an exciting 6v6 Water Polo Championship that combines swimming, teamwork, strategy, endurance, and competitive gameplay. Teams compete in the water through fast-paced passing, attacking movements, defensive plays, and goal-scoring opportunities, creating an energetic and engaging sporting experience for both participants and spectators.

name: Startup Street 11
short_description: Startup Street XI is a 24-hour flagship entrepreneurship marathon where innovators transform ideas into impactful ventures. Participants brainstorm, validate, strategize, and refine business concepts under expert mentorship before presenting Shark Tank-style pitches. The event fosters innovation, collaboration, networking, and experiential learning, empowering aspiring entrepreneurs to create scalable, real-world solutions.
tagline: Ideas Today. Startups Tomorrow. Where Ideas Meet Investors' Eyes.

name: Beyond XI : FIFA Football Auction
short_description: Beyond XI is an exciting FIFA Football Auction where strategy meets football passion! Build your dream XI by bidding for players, outsmart your opponents, and create a squad strong enough to dominate the game.

name: StarParty
club: Students For the Exploration and Development of Space(SEDS)-VIT
venue: Dr. Ambedkar Auditorium + TT Basketball Court
short_description:
*Stargazing. Telescopes. Rooftops. Games.*

Just a few words that capture the magic of *Starparty*—where freshers head to the rooftop, look through powerful telescopes, and experience the night sky up close, while enjoying fun space-themed games, quizzes, and interactive sessions.
tagline: Explore The Night Sky Like Never Before.

name: Celestial Dive 5.0
short_description: Celestial Dive 5.0 is a journey beyond Earth. Spend an unforgettable night exploring the cosmos through powerful telescopes, uncovering the mysteries of the universe through engaging astronomy sessions and experiencing immersive planetariums that bring space to life. Enhanced by a carefully crafted moonlit ambiance, every moment is designed to inspire wonder, curiosity and a deeper connection with the universe.

name: Multipli Hackathon - Build. Innovate. Compete.
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: Multipli Hackathon is a 36-hour innovation challenge organized in collaboration with Multipli.fi, encouraging participants to build real-world solutions across crypto, DeFi, tokenization, AI, drones, trading strategies, and other domains. Participants will receive mentorship from industry experts and Web3 builders, showcase their ideas, compete for exciting prizes, and gain opportunities for internships or full-time roles at Multipli.
tagline: Build Real. Innovate Boldly. Compete for Impact.

name: PrimerTrix
short_description: PrimerTrix is an interactive workshop designed to introduce participants to the fundamentals of primer design for PCR. Learn the principles behind selecting effective primers, understand the key parameters that influence specificity and efficiency, and apply these concepts through hands-on exercises. Whether you're new to molecular biology or looking to strengthen your bioinformatics skills, PrimerTrix offers a practical foundation for designing primers with confidence.
tagline: Master the Art of Primer Design

name: Forensic Minds 4.0
club: STUDENTS ASSOCIATION OF BIO-ENGINEERING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (SABEST)
short_description: Forensic Minds 4.0 is an immersive biotechnology and forensic science event that challenges  participants to solve a crime through evidence-based investigation. By employing techniques  such as DNA extraction, gel electrophoresis, blood typing, and evidence examination,  participants will uncover clues, eliminate suspects, and reach a logical conclusion. The event  encourages scientific inquiry, critical thinking, and collaborative problem-solving through a hands-on learning experience.

name: Squid Game 2.0: The Final Showdown
short_description:
Round 1: Red Light, Green Light (Precision and focus sprint across the obstacle zone) 
Round 2: FasTrack (Sudden-death team coordination and mini-game challenge) 
Round 3: Blind Blueprint Build (3-player blindfolded construction and spatial coordination challenge) 
Round 4: Constructing Arcadia (The Grand Finale: Hands-on brick/aggregate construction and load-bearing test)

name: Ctrl + Alt + Confuse
short_description: Ctrl + Alt + Confuse is a fun-filled strategy event where teams tackle dynamic challenges with constantly changing rules, hidden objectives, and unexpected twists. Success depends on adaptability, teamwork, and quick decision-making under pressure.
tagline: Think Fast. Adapt Faster. Expect Absolute Chaos.

name: z0d1ak CTF Finals
short_description: z0d1ak CTF Finals is the decisive round of ACM-VIT's Capture the Flag competition. Qualifying teams of up to five members face an advanced set of cybersecurity challenges that test technical depth, speed, strategy and teamwork before the final champions are determined. Only teams that have qualified through z0d1ak CTF Qualifiers and have recieved formal invite via e-mail would be eligible to participate in z0d1ak CTF Finals, in-person.
tagline: Solve this challenge. Make no mistakes.

name: Solar Heist
short_description: Solar Heist is a story-driven mystery adventure where participants become Energy Detectives on a mission to recover a stolen clean-energy technology. Teams solve puzzles, decode clues, uncover hidden evidence, and complete interactive challenges inspired by renewable energy concepts. Combining teamwork, strategy, observation, and logical thinking, the event delivers an immersive experience that is both entertaining and educational.

name: Glowchella
short_description: GLOWCHELLA is a thrilling Squid Game inspired chemical engineering survival challenge where only the fastest and most creative teams survive. Face a series of exciting hands-on challenges involving glowing polymers, fragrance formulation, reaction optimization, and precision-based games. Every round tests your teamwork, strategy, and scientific skills as you battle for exclusive rewards, unforgettable souvenirs, and the ultimate title of Glowchella Champion.

name: VANTAGE – Visionary Assembly for New Technology, Advocacy, and Global Ethics
short_description: VANTAGE(Visionary Assembly for New Technology, Advocacy, and Global Ethics)  is a one-day flagship event by the Debate Society that brings together technology, policy, and public speaking. It features a keynote by an industry or policy leader, followed by a Turncoat Speaking Competition where participants argue both sides of AI and technology governance motions. Through critical thinking and persuasive speaking, VANTAGE challenges participants to engage with the most pressing technological issues of our time.

name: AIoTopia: Future with IoT
short_description: Step into the world of connected intelligence with AIoTopia! Discover how IoT, AI, Cloud  Computing, Data Analytics, Deep Learning, and Generative AI come together to power smart  ecosystems. Learn how data from connected devices is transformed into actionable insights  and real-world solutions across healthcare, smart cities, and industry. This beginner-friendly  workshop explores technology, innovation, future trends, and exciting career opportunities in  the digital age.
tagline: AIoTopia: Where AI Meets IoT, and Innovation Begins.

name: S.O.S
short_description: S.O.S. is a fast-paced audio-visual guessing challenge where participants must decode a series of scrambled songs, distorted audio clips, mixed signals, and chaotic movie scenes. As clues become increasingly confusing and unpredictable, teams must rely on their observation, memory, and quick thinking to identify the correct movies, songs, or media references. Navigate through the noise, decipher the transmissions, and answer the call for S.O.S.
tagline: Sense the senseless , See through chaos

name: Cloud Intelligence - An AWS AI Workshop
short_description: Cloud Intelligence – An AWS AI Workshop is a hands-on learning experience designed to build a strong foundation in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI on AWS. Led by an AWS Hero, the workshop explores powerful services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Rekognition, Comprehend, and more. Participants will learn prompt engineering, responsible AI, and cloud-based AI application development through practical demonstrations. Whether you’re beginning your AI journey or preparing for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner certification, this workshop is your opportunity to learn, build, and explore the future of AI on AWS.
tagline: Learn AI. Build with AWS. Shape What’s Next

name: CHAOTIC CANVAS
short_description: Chaotic Canvas is an interactive art and craft workshop designed to encourage creativity, self-expression, and hands-on learning. Participants will engage in creative activities and challenges such as canvas painting, bracelet making, and tote bag customization. The event provides an inclusive environment where individuals can explore artistic techniques, develop creative skills, and take home personalized creations as lasting mementos.
tagline: Where your story finds a canvas

name: ForkThis
short_description:
ForkThis is CSI-VIT's flagship open-source event, with Day 1 dedicated to an offline workshop focused on mastering Git and GitHub. Conducted by CSI core members, the session enhances workplace competencies through theory, hands-on demonstrations, and real-world implementation of version control. The workshop covers repositories, branching, commits, and pull requests, and also features an exclusive guest speaker session by an industry expert, sharing valuable insights on open-source development and career opportunities.

Days 2 and 3 feature a two-day online open-source competition where participants will work on bug-fix projects across multiple difficulty levels. They will submit their solutions through GitHub, compete on a live leaderboard, and stand a chance to win exciting prize money while applying the concepts learned during the workshop in a practical setting.

name: Ecopreneurs
club: NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF STUDENTS OF ARCHITECTURE (NASA)
short_description: Ecopreneurs is a 2-day Sustainability Product Design Hackathon that brings together students from diverse disciplines to create innovative solutions for environmental and societal challenges. Aligned with SDGs 7, 9, 11, 12, and 13, the event focuses on sustainable product innovation. Day 1 involves ideation, research, and design development, while Day 2 focuses on prototype development and pitching to an expert jury. The hackathon encourages interdisciplinary collaboration, creativity, entrepreneurship, and impact-driven design, providing participants with a platform to transform ideas into practical, sustainable solutions.

name: Soul Scribe
short_description: This event is designed to evaluate participants’ creativity, narrative development and adaptability in storytelling. The event is divided into 2 rounds.
tagline: A lore that demands your soul

name: Padakkalam 2.0
short_description: Padakkalam 2.0 is a high-energy competition blending mystery, strategy, and teamwork. Anveshippin Kandethum challenges participants through an exciting treasure hunt, while Padavettu: The Ultimate Showdown puts their tactical and strategic skills to the test through engaging tabletop gameplay.

name: The Hexagon Protocol
short_description: Think you've got what it takes to solve the unknown? The Hexagon Protocol invites you to embark on a thrilling adventure where every stage reveals new clues, fresh challenges, and unexpected twists. Work with your team to think critically, make strategic decisions, and adapt to an ever-changing game. Every choice shapes your journey, and every challenge brings you closer to uncovering the mystery. Gather your team, embrace the adventure, and discover if you can crack the protocol.
tagline: Decode the Unknown. Conquer the Challenge.

name: Humanity Through Lens
short_description: Humanity Through Lens is an NSS photography competition that encourages participants to capture powerful moments of kindness, community service, environmental conservation, and social responsibility. Through compelling photographs and meaningful captions, participants showcase real-life stories that inspire positive change. The event aims to promote empathy, creativity, and social awareness while highlighting the impact of small actions in building a better society.
tagline: Every Picture Tells a Story of Change

name: MEDVERSE
short_description: MedTech Roulette challenges teams to solve real-world healthcare problems using randomly assigned technologies. Design, prototype, and defend your solution as clinical curveballs and stakeholder hurdles put your innovation to the ultimate test.
tagline: Random Tech. Real Problems. Real Solutions

name: The Grand GraVITas Quiz
short_description: The Grand graVITas Quiz is DBQC’s premier Sci-Biz-Tech quiz, bringing together science, business, technology, and current affairs in an engaging contest of knowledge, reasoning, and analytical thinking. Participants compete through challenging preliminary and final rounds that reward curiosity, speed, and interdisciplinary problem-solving.

name: Trail of secrets
short_description: They say the greatest secrets are never found... they're earned. Trail of Secrets is not just a treasure hunt—it's a relentless race where every clue pulls you deeper into the unknown. Hidden messages, deceptive twists, and mind-bending riddles stand between you and the ultimate prize. Every second counts, every choice matters, and one wrong move could leave your team behind. Trust no assumptions, question everything, and push your instincts to the limit. Only the fastest minds, the strongest teamwork, and the bravest explorers will survive the trail and uncover the secret that everyone else missed. Are you ready to take the risk?
tagline: One Trail. Endless Secrets. Will you conquer the trail... or become its next secret?

name: Exploring AI, IoT and Cybersecurity for the Digital Era
club: School of Computer Science Engineering and Information Systems
short_description: Exploring AI, IoT and Cybersecurity for the Digital Era is a hands-on workshop introducing students to three transformative technologies shaping the future. Through live demonstrations, practical examples, and interactive sessions, participants will explore AI, smart IoT systems, cybersecurity, ethical hacking, digital forensics, and AI-driven cyber defense. The workshop also highlights career opportunities, certifications, internships, research, and innovation pathways for building a future-ready technology career.
tagline: Explore. Innovate. Secure. Shape the Digital Future.

name: Smart Cobots: AI in Modern Industrial Automation
short_description: This one-day technical workshop introduces participants to AI driven Collaborative Robots (Cobots) and their applications in Industry 4.0. Through expert sessions and live demonstrations, attendees will explore how Artificial Intelligence, IoT, and cloud technologies are transforming industrial automation. The workshop equips students with practical insights into intelligent manufacturing, human robot collaboration, and future career opportunities in smart industries.
tagline: Empowering the Future of Manufacturing with AI-Driven Collaborative Robotics.

name: ByteQuest
short_description:
ByteQuest: Clear Mind. Clean Code. is an 8-hour college hackathon where teams build innovative tech solutions for real-world social challenges across 4 cause-driven tracks.
What makes it different? Teams receive 500 virtual ByteCoins and use them to bid for problem statements, buy resources, hire talent, and gain strategic advantages. Throughout the day, they face surprise curveballs, investor grilling, and last-minute challenges that test their creativity, technical skills, adaptability, and entrepreneurial thinking.

name: MOJO UNCHAINED: Take Two
short_description: Ever watched a movie scene and thought, “I wonder if I could make that”? Now’s your chance. Pick a scene you love and bring it to life with your team — recreate it shot-for-shot, or flip it with your own twists, style, and creativity. Learn the basics of filmmaking by actually making something, compete for cash prizes, and get your work judged by filmmakers. Not behind the camera? Come watch, experience the creations, and see what you could make yourself.
tagline: Recreate the scene. Rewrite the rules. Make it yours.

name: Game Of Tones
short_description: Games of Tones is an interactive competition where science, sustainability, and Westerosi spirit collide. Your journey begins with an Oathtaking to place your team into an iconic Game of Thrones house. Craft eco-friendly paints from scratch, then clash in a Rapid Fire Round to win rare pigments and special additives like waterproofing or magnetic properties. Once tested, paint your house sigil on canvas, design a custom wooden keychain, and take home a vial of your handcrafted paint. When you play the Game of Tones, you either paint or you dye!
tagline: All must Paint! All must Dye!

name: Modelling Minds 2.0
short_description: Modelling Minds 2.0 goes beyond theoretical knowledge by encouraging participants to develop practical, scalable, and innovative AI solutions under time constraints. Whether you're exploring Machine Learning for the first time or building advanced AI agents, this event provides an exciting platform to learn, compete, and showcase your problem-solving abilities.
tagline: From Data to Decisions, From Agents to Action.

name: Code Or Chaos
short_description: :A gamified competitive-programming event built on a 3-life system — participants lose a life for a compile/syntax error, not for a wrong answer. Once all lives are lost, the participant must clear a quick eSports duel (chess blitz or reflex duel) or a short physical trial (e.g. push-ups) at a live Respawn Station to regain a life and continue. A live “hearts” leaderboard on screen makes it spectator-friendly and brings coding, eSports, and physical activity into one event.

name: Compile or Die
short_description: :A gamified competitive-programming event built on a 3-life system — participants lose a life for a compile/syntax error, not for a wrong answer. Once all lives are lost, the participant must clear a quick eSports duel (chess blitz or reflex duel) or a short physical trial (e.g. push-ups) at a live Respawn Station to regain a life and continue. A live “hearts” leaderboard on screen makes it spectator-friendly and brings coding, eSports, and physical activity into one event.

name: Power and Precision Challenge
short_description: An interactive TechnoSports football challenge where participants test their shot power and accuracy using a ball-speed measurement system and an electronic target goal. Each participant gets five attempts to score points by hitting different target zones, while their shot speed is also recorded. The event combines football with simple sports technology to create a competitive and engaging experience for participants and spectators.

name: SAE GRAND PRIX
short_description: SAE GRAND PRIX 2026 is an overnight Formula 1-inspired strategy experience where teams battle through qualifying, driver auctions, car development, race simulations, FIA politics, and crisis management. Teams of four must balance budgets, build competitive cars, make high-pressure strategic decisions, defend their choices before the FIA, and survive unexpected race-weekend chaos. From the first bid to the final podium, every decision can change the championship.
tagline: Enter the Paddock. Own the Race

name: Bricks By Bid 2.0
short_description: Bricks by Bid is an immersive strategy-based city-building competition where teams step into the role of ambitious real estate developers, competing to create the most valuable property portfolio. Starting with an equal budget, participants must bid for limited construction materials, negotiate trades, and make strategic investment decisions while adapting to an ever-changing marketplace. Every choice influences the team's journey, from acquiring resources to expanding their portfolio and planning for the final challenge. Combining business strategy, teamwork, negotiation, and calculated risk-taking, Bricks by Bid offers an exciting and competitive experience where only the smartest planners and decision-makers will build their way to victory.
tagline: Your Moves Decide the deal. Your strategy seals the win.

name: Design Dev
short_description: Design Dev is a hackathon where imagination matters more than code. Teams design a complete indie game concept — including a title, character design, UI mockup, and storyline — without writing a single line of backend logic. It's a rare hackathon format built for artists, writers, and designers as much as developers, where the challenge is bringing a fully realized game world to life through pure creative vision.

name: Aqua Arena (WOMEN)
short_description: Aqua Arena is a thrilling 3v3 Water Volleyball tournament that combines teamwork, strategy, and fast-paced gameplay on a specially designed water court. Played in a single-elimination knockout format, the event offers participants a fun and refreshing competitive experience while promoting sportsmanship, coordination, and team spirit. With an energetic atmosphere and exciting matches, Aqua Arena promises to be one of the most engaging attractions of graVITas 2026

name: INFRANOVA - IDEATHON
club: INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF AUTOMATION AND ROBOTICS IN CONSTRUCTION (IAARC)
short_description: INFRANOVA is an ideathon focused on developing innovative and practical solutions for proactive infrastructure maintenance. Participants will identify ways to address real-world civil infrastructure challenges using interdisciplinary approaches such as AI, IoT, GIS, robotics, data analytics, automation, and sustainable engineering. Teams will progress from idea submission to prototype development and finally present their solution before a panel of experts.
tagline: Your Idea. Your Innovation. Your Impact.

name: Bioblunder 2.0
short_description: BioBlunder 2.0 is a reverse-engineering hackathon where participants are presented with a fully conceptualized biotechnology product, complete with documented limitations grounded in real biological, ecological, and engineering principles. Teams must critically evaluate the product, propose scientifically sound improvements, and be prepared to defend their reasoning as the scenario evolves. The event emphasizes analytical depth and adaptability over conventional ideation.
tagline: Diagnose the flaw. Engineer the solution. Defend the science.

name: CookOff 11
short_description: GraVITas' longest-running competitive coding event is back for its 11th edition! With its all-new format, CookOff 11 is set to push veterans and rising stars alike to achieve algorithmic feats they thought impossible. CookOff 11 is a high-stakes arena of logic, speed, and structural elegance. We invite you to be a part of its legacy.

name: Squish and Sculpt
short_description: Squish & Sculpt is a relaxed, hands-on clay-modeling session by The Cubing Club. No competition, no judging — just clay, colors, and your imagination. Sculpt a character, creature, object, or something totally abstract, solo or with friends. All materials are provided, so just show up ready to get your hands a little messy and make something fun.
tagline: Grab some clay, sculpt something fun.

name: CivilOPoly
short_description: Experience a one-of-a-kind technical event where engineering knowledge meets the thrill of Monopoly! Battle through exciting quiz rounds, earn construction materials, and race against time to build the tallest and most stable structure.

name: CUBESAT 2.0
short_description: The CubeSat Workshop is a one-day hands-on learning experience designed to introduce participants to the fundamentals of aerospace engineering through practical application. Participants will build a functional cube-sized satellite using real electronic components while exploring key concepts in aerospace, robotics, and electronics. The workshop covers essential satellite subsystems, including power management, sensor modules, and communication systems. Designed for beginners, it requires no prior technical knowledge and welcomes students from all disciplines. Through guided activities and collaborative learning, participants gain valuable technical skills and practical insights, effectively bridging the gap between classroom theory and real-world engineering applications.

name: Knot & Strand
short_description: Knot and Strand is a three-round strategy and management event that challenges teams to demonstrate resource allocation, risk assessment, bidding, puzzle-solving, and decision- making skills. Teams of 3 members progress through a structure-building challenge, strategic delivery bidding, and a final high-stakes route selection round. Resources and scores carry forward across rounds, with the team achieving the highest cumulative score declared the winner.

name: Insight for Impact
short_description: Insight for Impact empowers you to turn raw data into compelling visuals, uncover meaningful insights, and master the art of data storytelling to drive smarter decisions and real-world impact.
tagline: From Raw Data to Powerful Insights

name: ABSOLUTE CINEMA
short_description: Absolute Cinema is a workshop-style event where a simulated reactor meltdown has trapped teams of 3-4 participants in a time loop across iconic cinematic universes. Acting as elite chemical engineers, teams must use science, quick thinking, and teamwork to complete a series of unique STEM and chemistry experiments inspired by popular movies and shows like Stranger Things, Star Wars, and Jurassic Park. The ultimate goal is to solve these high-stakes laboratory challenges to repair the fractured timeline and escape the multiverse before time runs out.

name: Human Bandwidth
short_description: Human Bandwidth is a mix of a coding competition and a physical scavenger hunt. Instead of getting a full problem statement upfront, teams of two to four people have to actually go out and find their project requirements. Teammates can split up however they want into "Readers" who track down hidden clues and "Coders" who stay behind to build the software. The event follows a trail of six required hints and two optional bonus challenges. Every clue gives a specific coding requirement and tells the team exactly where the next hint is hiding. The hunting and coding happen at the same time before a hard deadline, so teams have to communicate and strategize on the fly. When time is up, projects are graded on how well those hidden requirements were implemented in the code.
tagline: Find it. Code it. Compile it..

name: AERIAL YOGA
short_description: Aerial Yoga is a unique fitness and wellness activity that combines the principles of traditional yoga with the support of a specially designed fabric hammock suspended from the ceiling. The hammock serves as a prop that assists participants in performing yoga postures, stretches, and balance exercises with greater ease while reducing strain on the joints and spine. By integrating elements of yoga, Pilates, flexibility training, and mindfulness, aerial yoga offers a holistic experience that enhances physical strength, improves flexibility, and promotes mental relaxation

name: Energy Nexus
short_description: What if the future of energy rested in your hands? Step into Energy Nexus, where your team becomes a global energy company navigating high-stakes decisions, unexpected crises, and fierce competition. Build your empire, negotiate strategic deals, manage resources, and adapt to a rapidly changing world where every choice shapes your success. There are no perfect answers—only bold strategies. Balance Profit, People, and the Planet, outsmart your rivals, and prove you have what it takes to lead the future of energy.
tagline: Profit. People. Planet. Choose Your Legacy.

name: The Phantom Protocol
short_description: The Phantom Protocol is an immersive, strategy-based game event where participants solve technical challenges while uncovering hidden Phantoms among their teammates. Every player receives a secret role, making trust and deception equally important throughout the game. As teams tackle puzzles, riddles, and logic-based missions, they must also identify the players secretly working against them. Success depends on problem-solving, observation, teamwork, communication, and smart decision-making under pressure, creating an exciting experience where every clue matters and every move could reveal the Phantom.

name: The Great Indoor Tech Race
short_description: The Great Indoor Tech Race is a fast-paced team strategy event where participants compete through multiple challenge rounds involving communication, logic, AI tools, UI/UX problem-solving, and crisis management. Teams earn points by showcasing creativity, teamwork, speed, and decision-making skills. The event culminates in a high-pressure finale where finalists present innovative solutions to real-world corporate challenges.

name: Aman Gupta Unplugged
short_description: Aman Gupta Unplugged is an exclusive, interactive session featuring candid conversations, real-world insights, and stories from Aman Gupta’s entrepreneurial journey. The experience brings together an engaging anchor-led Q&A, an insightful talk, and an open audience Q&A — giving attendees the chance to listen, learn, and ask their questions directly.

name: Aqua Beats (MEN)
short_description: Aqua Zumba is an exciting fitness and wellness activity that combines the energetic movements of Zumba with the natural resistance of water. Conducted in a swimming pool, the session allows participants to perform rhythmic exercises, stretches, and dance-based movements while reducing stress on the joints and muscles. By integrating elements of aerobics, dance, flexibility training, and mindfulness, Aqua Zumba offers a holistic experience that enhances physical fitness, improves coordination, and promotes mental relaxation.

name: Pixelens2.0
short_description: An interactive workshop on Blender, the world's most popular free 3D animation software.
tagline: Render the world you want to see

name: Aqua Beats (WOMEN)
short_description: Aqua Zumba is an exciting fitness and wellness activity that combines the energetic movements of Zumba with the natural resistance of water. Conducted in a swimming pool, the session allows participants to perform rhythmic exercises, stretches, and dance-based movements while reducing stress on the joints and muscles. By integrating elements of aerobics, dance, flexibility training, and mindfulness, Aqua Zumba offers a holistic experience that enhances physical fitness, improves coordination, and promotes mental relaxation.

name: MIRAI
short_description: MIRAI: The Humanoid Experience is a flagship event at Gravitas 2026, VIT Vellore, bringing a first-of-its-kind humanoid tics experience to the campus. For the very first time, attendees will witness live humanoid ts, AI-driven demonstrations, interactive exhibits, and emerging technologies in one immersive event. Designed to inspire innovation and curiosity, MIRAI offers a unique opportunity to explore the future of tics, artificial intelligence, and automation while engaging with one of South India's most exciting technology showcases.
